steps.text: Name?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Dorothy.
Please provide your full name.
I suggest you cooperate. This conversation will be recorded in its entirety.
Our next course of action hinges on the results of our investigation, in conjunction with the findings of our interrogation.
This will affect the fates of both you and those involved with Site 359.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Alright, I understand.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: My full name is Dorothy Franks.

steps.name: Basket-holding Girl
steps.text: Dorothy! Dorothy! Come take a look, hurry!

steps.name: Basket-holding Girl
steps.text: There's a giant meadow just up ahead!

steps.name: Basket-holding Girl
steps.text: You can see everything from there, so let's try to find your home! Um...a silver house...

steps.name: Golosse
steps.text: GO... GO-LOS-SEE!

steps.name: Basket-holding Girl
steps.text: Hey, Golosse! Move your balloon outta the way a little!

steps.name: Basket-holding Girl
steps.text: You're blocking the view!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I already took a good look, Veggie.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: No silver house here... I guess my home is someplace else.

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: Oh...that's fine, my home isn't here either.

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: It's beautiful out here, but still not as nice as the wheat field back home!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Hm? Golosse... what's wrong? Trying to get me to look at something?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Ah... I think there's someone over there.
Good day to you all.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: G-Good day, Mr. Vulpo! You look like you're in some sort of trouble?

steps.name: Curbside Vulpo
steps.text: I can't find my home.

steps.name: Curbside Vulpo
steps.text: I was arguing with my brother, and it got so bad we almost brought the house down. I ran away and vowed never to return.

steps.name: Curbside Vulpo
steps.text: So I ended up here... It's so scary outside and I want to go home, but I can't.

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: Why not? Are you lost?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: If you can't find your way home, you can join us to look for it.

steps.name: Curbside Vulpo
steps.text: Alright, I'll tag along with you kind ladies and this... balloon-carrying robot.

steps.name: Curbside Vulpo
steps.text: But I'm telling you, when you see my home, you'll understand why I said I could never go back.

steps.name: Curbside Vulpo
steps.text: By the way, I'm not a Vulpo. I'm a proud Aslan.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: So, your goal was to find your 'home?'

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: And at the same time, help those Pioneers find their own 'homes?'

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: I came to Site 359 to find out what happened here.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: So I'll ask you politely not to stall my investigation with vague wording.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm not trying to do anything like that. I really was looking for home.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: If you don't mind, could I confirm one more time—

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: All other the personnel from Site 359, as well as the Pioneers, they've all been relocated?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: I'm under no obligation to answer your questions.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Why is it you're so concerned with those Pioneers?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Your mother was a Pioneer as well, is that correct?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: You spent your childhood with her and her fellow Pioneers, is that correct?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: And your mother died in a Catastrophe out in the wilderness, is that correct?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I rather not talk about that, sir.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm sure you know my background well enough... But what does that have to do with your investigation?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Right. I apologize if my phrasing has upset you.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: My working theory goes like this: Those people must have been very important to you.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The Pioneers... they wander the wilderness until they can go no further.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: They migrate from one end to another, like a storm with nowhere to go. They may be called Pioneers, but they have no land to call their own.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I wanted to give them a better life.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: As for my loved ones... I will carry on for them, to return to their 'homes,' the ones they've visited so many times in their dreams.

steps.name: Golosse
steps.text: GO-LOS-SEE.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Here?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Golosse... This is your home?

steps.name: Golosse
steps.text: GO.

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: Seems like its trying to tell us something... look at its hands.

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: Do you think it's asking us to open that drawer for it?

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: Drawer? What could be inside...? Let me see!

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: It's... a recorder?

steps.name: Golosse
steps.text: Home... home...

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: Hey! Did... did Golosse just say a word?!
The robot begins to disassemble itself.
The balloon that it has been holding floats to the ceiling.
The robot opens its chest to reveal its 'core,' and places its 'heart' into the recorder.
The recorder gives off a voice... an elderly voice.

steps.name: Old Voice
steps.text: *Cough*... I am Golosse, a robot craftsman.

steps.name: Old Voice
steps.text: I can't walk anymore, and I'm still a long way from home.

steps.name: Old Voice
steps.text: I recorded my voice and implanted it into this body. I hope this robot can bring it back home for me.

steps.name: Old Voice
steps.text: Dear stranger...

steps.name: Old Voice
steps.text: If anyone hears this... please go and see for me, find out what's become of my home...

steps.name: Old Voice
steps.text: Go on, robot, carry my voice back home!
The elderly voice stops.

steps.name: Golosse
steps.text: LOSE...
The robot makes one final sound before reverting to a heap of cold steel.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Golosse... I know that's not your name, but I still think I should call you that... you did it.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But what you've accomplished, is more than just acting as a proxy to carry your master's voice to a long lost home.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: This place... is your home too.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Mr. Lupo.

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: What is it? And I'm not a Lupo, I'm an Aslan.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Alright, Mr. Aslan... could you help me fetch Golosse's balloon?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I want to bring its balloon with us, and carry on.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Let's get back on track. In regards to your cooperation with the military, I see Ferdinand was your liaison, and your experiments appear to have been fully compliant with the law, so far.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Let me clarify your personal relationship, which appears to have been very close? Were you really unaware of what he was planning?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm sorry, but I never knew him that well.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Fair enough. We have no evidence that you knew what he was up to.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Records show a pattern of accessing internal Rhine Lab documents typical for a researcher.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm always pressed for time. I just wish my experiments could be faster and better... I don't have the luxury of exploring unrelated materials.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: You say that, but what you've accomplished is still pretty incredible.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: No ordinary person would avoid obtaining information like that, let alone a Rhine Lab Director.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: We have reason to suspect you prepared these records to clear yourself of suspicion.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Preparing false records for a post-event investigation wouldn't help me complete my experiments faster, nor would it help the Pioneers.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: So why would I do that?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Wouldn't you be curious about your role in his plans? Wouldn't you want to know if he saw you as a partner or a pawn?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: No, that really wouldn't make a difference to me at all.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: My research, my vision... that's what matters to me. And it could be extraordinarily valuable to someone else.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: If that someone else wants to make use of my research and vision, I'm willing to make a trade.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: So you're saying you don't mind being a pawn. You're not afraid of being used, of suffering damages?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: By suffering damages... do you mean getting put behind bars?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: That could very well happen...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Yes, I'm aware. It happened to Loken Williams... I've seen my share of scientists who've made enough mistakes for the government to abandon them.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: However, I do know there are quite a few people who get themselves thrown in prison just to look for Loken, to ask for his advice and assistance on their research, as I once did.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Ahem. That is to say, you've made your own terrible decisions.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: That road I've walked... is how I managed to get a leg up on the competition. It's essentially how Columbia functions.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: How else could the daughter of a Pioneer become a Director of Rhine Lab?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Who would've thought... you've even thought through these things? But... you may not care if you're being used, sure. How about the Pioneers?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Ferdinand and the others may see you as an equal, but when it comes to the Pioneers, they might as well be plastic bags littered out in the wilderness after they're no longer useful, huh?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Well... they will eventually pay their dues.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Even if I can't see things through now, I will eventually. It's my responsibility, after my mistakes.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: That was... the biggest mistake I've ever made.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Mr. Feline!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Mr. Feline? What are you standing there for? We need to go!

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: I'm not a Vulpo or a Feline. I'm an Aslan.

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: Miss, this is the last time I'll correct you. If it happens again, you'll see the back of my sharp molars instead.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Alright, Mr. Aslan. Come along with us now.

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: You go on ahead, I've already found my home.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Your home? Where is it...?

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: Look up.
An upside-down house hangs above Dorothy's head, floating in the vast sky.
Dorothy finally realizes why Mr. 'Aslan' said he could never return home.

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: I made an irreversible mistake, with only my own pride to blame, and now I have left my home for good.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Mr. 'Aslan,' there must be a way to get you back. We just have to put our heads together!

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: You go ahead, I'll stay here. This is the punishment I deserve.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Floating... in the sky...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I've got it!

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Mr. 'Aslan!' We still have Golosse's balloon!

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: Balloon...? You're going to float me up with that?

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: I'll try... I think it's working, my feet are off the ground! I just need to lose some more weight!

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: Oh my! Mr. 'Aslan,' what are you doing...? Is this... water?

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: There's so much... Why is it coming out of your ears?

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: Heheh... I gulped down all that water just to make myself look stronger.

steps.name: Mr. 'Aslan'
steps.text: It's like my brain has been bobbing up and down in my head this whole time... Look at me! I'm flying!
The 'Aslan' rises slowly up into the air with the balloon—he is screaming, but it is unclear if from panic or excitement.
For just a moment, Dorothy gets a look at his back molars—they aren't sharp at all. In fact, they're round and cute.
For some unknown reason, Dorothy sheds a tear.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: What do you know about Kristen Wright's plans?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Nothing at all.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You may not believe it, but it's the truth.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm sorry to say, I'm probably the most out-of-touch person in all of Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Do you know where she might be right now?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm very sorry, but I really don't.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: All I know is that she's an idealist. And a very ambitious one.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: When she invited me to join Rhine, I saw the same kind of idealistic 'lightning bolt' that I have in her.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Lightning bolt?
An unusual figure appears in the skies above Trimounts.
A pillar of light pierces the sky, and at the moment the truth behind the azure blue pours out for only a moment.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: What... is that...?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: What's happening in the sky over Trimounts?!

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Is... is that Kristen's 'ambitious target?!'

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Director Franks.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Director? Are... are you crying?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: So that's the truth behind the sky... It's beautiful.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm sorry, I just can't hold back my tears.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I expected nothing less from Kristen... She really did it.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Director, you just said you didn't know what Kristen's plans were?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: This definitely looks like something she would do.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: And... I'm feeling something genuine.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: It's my 'Transmitter.'

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I can feel it through the 'Transmitter'... They've gone to the other side of the sky—

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The river of stars does not hide from its impulse to rush into my mind...

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: 'Transmitter', huh?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: That sounds like the product of the experiments at Site 359.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: I am curious... since you're so closely linked with this creation, did exposure to it result in any negative effects?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Like a side effect?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: You could put it that way.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I haven't experienced any particularly noticeable symptoms so far.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: If you really press me on it, I do seem to dream a lot more.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Sometimes I can't tell if I'm awake or asleep... or I suddenly feel...

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Feel what?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Director Franks. Director Franks?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Oh... Sorry about that, the feeling just came by again.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Like I'm in a hot, arid, deserted wasteland.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Hot...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: So hot...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Veggie... slow down a little...

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: Dorothy, I've reached my stop. This place here's my home.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Huh? Here...? But it's so hot... too hot for anything to ever grow.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Where's the wheat field you talked about? The beautiful new brick house... and your friend who's been waiting for you in the fields?

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: Uh... my friend, isn't he right next to us?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Here? Oh...are you talking about this raggedy scarecrow?

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: Yeah, hehe, it's been so long. I didn't expect him to change this much...

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: And my home too... it's much bigger.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Veggie...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Why don't you come with me? You can live with me!

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: Dorothy, you've come such a long way with us.

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: Golosse, Mr. 'Aslan,' and me... we all appreciate you keeping us company on our journey.

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: But now is the time to say goodbye.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: B-But, I'm just worried...

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: It's alright, Dorothy. I've decided to stay here.

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: Even if it has changed a lot... this place is still my home. My friend... he's been here the whole time.

steps.name: Veggie
steps.text: I'll stay with him and rebuild our home together.
A breeze blows, and the scarecrow sways with the wind.
Dorothy bids farewell to her last remaining friend.
The desert spans far and wide, but where lies the silver house from her memories?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Kristen has lost her goddamned mind...

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Just what kind of monsters has she gathered in Rhine Lab...?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Kristen... is this what she wanted to find? The answer to the question of 'home?'

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I'm going to have to congratulate Control, the next time I see her.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: And Parvis... It looks like he's modified my creation. Hmm, now that's interesting.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But 'Transmitter' is just a 'Transmitter', so if it's not used to sustain life, then what does it do?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Wait... I suddenly thought of a possibility.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Life can't survive outside starpods, but that might not be the case for a 'Transmitter.' So maybe—they could take the place of humans in harsher environments, be it in the center of a Catastrophe, or...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: This is wonderful, Sir, please give me a little time. I need to imprint this scene in my head, and note down everything I'm thinking right now.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: There is still so much more room for improvement in my experiments with endless possibilities for what the Transmitters could become, the equality I want, the future I want, the... home I long for...

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: What exactly is this 'home' you keep bringing up? You don't mean it's... in the sky?
Home?
What I call home... my futurescape...
What does it look like?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: This...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Is this my house? This silver house...

steps.name: Motherly Voice
steps.text: Dorothy, over here...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: That's Mama's voice...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Mama... where are you? I can't find you...?

steps.name: Motherly Voice
steps.text: Dorothy, over here...

a.text: Dorothy, this shouldn't be your futurescape...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Futurescape...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Then where should it be?

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Director Franks, I'd like you to stop talking to yourself.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: And answer my question.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Alright. I was just recalling my inspiration there.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The 'home' I'm talking about is not the one you're thinking of.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: What I seek is a more egalitarian, idealistic society, and it might just be right under our feet. Or it could be much farther away, as far away as Kristen is looking.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Now that I'm thinking about it again, Kristen, Parvis, Ferdinand, and me, we Rhine Lab scientists all have our separate goals.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: If I'm looking for what we have it common... I might say... the brilliant 'lightning bolt' I see blazing in all of us.
Dorothy notices the investigator hitting the pause button on the recorder.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Director Franks, I think I need to remind you of something.

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: Suppose you pursue your ideals in a manner similar to that of Kristen, Ferdinand, or any of the others—

steps.name: Investigator
steps.text: What you just said might have unfortunate consequences for you.
A wind blows from an unknown direction.
...The scent of the wilderness.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Otti.

steps.name: Otti
steps.text: How... do you know my name?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Why not hear my story first?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I once helped a Pioneer by the name of Linda.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: She was forcibly separated from her family at a young age and abandoned in the wilderness due to her Oripathy.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The time she spent with her family in the countryside was her most precious memory.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: When autumn came, that field of golden wheat... with the scarecrow swaying amidst the crops...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: And the brother who always tagged along behind her, running endlessly through the wheat fields...

steps.name: Otti
steps.text: You... know my sister?

steps.name: Otti
steps.text: How... is she now...? How has her life been?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: So it really is you. Linda showed me a photo of her family... The first time I saw you, I guessed that you were her brother.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: She got married, and even invited me to her wedding. It was a simple event, out in the wastes, but she married a decent man.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: They even have a child now. He's adorable, pestering his mother every day to hear the story of the scarecrow.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: She always said that her brother was her pride and joy... She was sure that the remarkable and responsible Otti would take care of the family for her.

steps.name: Otti
steps.text: I'm sorry... I don't even know what to say.

steps.name: Otti
steps.text: Should I be thanking you, Director Franks?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: There's no need for that, Otti. I'm telling you this story not because I want something in return.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I feel... duty-bound to help the Pioneers. I expect to keep pursuing my ideals, in the same way I have.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: So, my conscience can be clear.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Please put everything I've said on the record.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: The only thing that should not be traded is the love and goodwill of man.

steps.name: Otti
steps.text: I understand, Director Franks.
He switches the recorder on.
The next day...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You're here.

steps.name: Mysterious Visitor
steps.text: You knew I would be?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: You are an excellent partner.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I knew you would come find me, if you wanted even more responsibility.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Looking closer, I think you've grown again.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: The 'transmitter' was indeed utilized as you expected.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I should thank you for the tip.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I've agreed to cooperate with the government, so I came here to retrieve the 'transmitter.'

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Why don't we make a 'trade', my good doctor?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What do you want?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Where is Kristen right now? And where is Rhine Lab headed?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: At least, that was the only answer I had for a long time, for anything about Rhine Lab personnel, or any of the others.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What are you planning, to be asking such questions?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I want to remain at Rhine Lab, and continue my research.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Of course, it would be nice to travel around to meet other like-minded individuals, so my research could benefit even more people.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I think I remember, you're working with a company called Rhodes Island these days?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I am.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Do you think maybe... Rhodes Island would be willing to collaborate with me?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Everyone deserves the truth of science—I know, Olivia, this is our common dream.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: With you helping to keep the results of my work in the right hands—

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I believe that our dream will eventually be realized.
